note: The loved morphs: the raw Cloud Final clips of the morphs Tys named (his words are on each group), the only copies in open-weights quality (a seed does not bring a clip back: 10 of 30 identical reruns matched, so the clips are saved, not the seeds). Each plays from its `from` still to its `to` still, both shipped in src/xenoform/ui_static/objects, 24 fps, no audio. `style` is in the clip (the morph prompt's opening); `timing`, `effects`, `look`, `foreshadow` and `knobs` are what the cut did with it when it was composed (the raw clip has none of them). `seed` is the base seed 2727 plus the shot's index in its job. `effects` and `look` of `also_used_in` are those of the other job that used the same clip. The prompt is not stored per job: it is rebuilt from cloud_final.lead() and morph_pass.prompt_for(vibe, 'ltx25', kinds, style). `sha1` is the file's.
